name: eve-map-assistant
description: Find EVE systems and safely work with routes, jump ranges, markers, temporary Wormholes, and explicit Mission Normal navigation sending in EVE Static Map Planner.

interface.shortDescription: Ask naturally about the running EVE map
interface.longDescription: Use natural language to find EVE systems; safely plan, inspect, or visualize routes, jump ranges, temporary Missions, markers, and temporary Wormholes; and explicitly send an identified Mission Normal route to a selected EVE character.
defaultPrompt: What Wormholes are currently on the map?
